scope: Proposition 10.1 (Helicity matching) of the manuscript “Exact mass asymptotics for the two-dimensional O(4) lattice model” (preprints/Exact-mass-asymptotics-for-the-two-dimensional-O4-lattice-model-October-5-2026/exact-mass-o4.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4eb3ab28f7565322), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 98. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix the blocking factor L and the admission constants as in Sections 7–9. For every sufficiently large β, choose any matched trajectory satisfying (9.1), with its parameters b, r, cx, ct. For i = x, t, lim m→∞ lim sup s→∞ lim sup β→∞ hB i (mLs ) − hF i (mLs ) = 0, (10.1) where m tends to infinity through sufficiently large dyadic integers. The inner limit is taken with m and s fixed.
